plan.summary: BRO-5520: checked results from the owner’s Gemini deep research runs (2026-27 season and long-running hits; 2025-26 season). One new figure checks out: Joe Turner’s Come and Gone was capitalized at $8 million, stated by its producers in The RainMakers Collective investor Q&A (Feb 7, 2026). Two capitalizations in our data had no source and nothing behind them: Dog Day Afternoon’s $9.5M (its own note says none was reported; the number is Titanique’s) and Little Bear Ridge Road’s $4.1M (Rudin and Diller financed it alone; no coverage gives a cost). Both are cleared rather than printed as estimates. Rejected claims from the reports: Celebrity Autobiography “recouped $2.3M” (Playbill: it struggled and closed two months early), The Lion King ~$15M (a blog), Beaches’ $12.5M recoupment (Just in Time’s), All Out $31.5M (cited to an article written before the show existed).
steps: Joe Turner: capitalization, its source, and the note sentence that said none was reported.
Dog Day Afternoon and Little Bear Ridge Road: capitalization cleared and isEstimate.capitalization set to false; the model reruns on apply.
